name: Pack 7: your sound lab sounds
words: The sounds you chose in the sound lab, with your edits, on pack 4's grooves: your 808 kick, the real hats, dry hands and wood, FM round, an evolving pad, the glass stab, the FM marimba and bells.

sounds.name: Your 808 kick
sounds.words: The 808 kit's kick as you edited it in the sound lab: shorter, a little more punch, the mids cut.

sounds.name: Real hats
sounds.words: The analog drum machine's real hi-hat (the pair of cymbals you chose in the sound lab), and the ride from your edit.

sounds.name: Dry hands and wood
sounds.words: The dry toms and shaker you liked, the rim as you edited it on the 808, the clave dry, logs and a wood block from the toms and clave tuned down, a soft bowl and gong.

sounds.name: FM round
sounds.words: The analog synth's FM round from the sound lab: a sine shaken by one an octave up, evenly, falling away into a round, plain note.

sounds.name: Evolving pad
sounds.words: Written for the first song from the sound lab: a pulse whose width the LFO sweeps beside a detuned saw, through the soft ladder, its cutoff breathing on a slow LFO over two bars, warm, the mids cut.

sounds.name: Unison pad, gated
sounds.words: The unison pad you liked, gated in 16ths.

sounds.name: Glass stab, tamed
sounds.words: The glass stab from your palette: a narrow pulse and a saw an octave up, plucked shut, the mids cut, a dotted echo.

sounds.name: FM marimba
sounds.words: The FM marimba from your palette: a sine shaken two octaves up, falling away in an instant.

sounds.name: Ring bell, softer
sounds.words: The ring bell you liked, tamed and softened.

sounds.name: Poly bell, shorter
sounds.words: The native poly synth's glass bell, shorter, as you liked it.

harmonies.name: F minor add 9
harmonies.words: One chord, low and heavy (you chose it twice).

harmonies.name: A minor 7
harmonies.words: One plain chord: the movement all in the rhythm.

harmonies.name: A pedal, the top moving
harmonies.words: A minor 7, sus4, minor 9 over the same A.

harmonies.name: D minor 7 ↔ 9
harmonies.words: One root, the ninth coming and going.

harmonies.name: A semitone up and back
harmonies.words: E minor 7, then F major 7, 8 bars each.

harmonies.name: Sus2 drift
harmonies.words: C sus2 and D sus2, 4 bars each.
